narrative_purpose: Show that the serene lift a caravan climbs on has violently turbulent air rolling directly beneath it, so the knowledge that keeps a fleet alive is not where the lift is but how far above the danger it begins.
subject: A vertical contrast in one frame. In the UPPER portion: three smooth almond-shaped lens clouds spaced along a gentle rising-and-falling crest line, each with hard clean edges, polished laminar surfaces and utterly still forms, serene and glassy. In the LOWER portion, directly beneath those almonds and much closer to the ground: one long violently churning horizontal roll of torn ragged cloud lying on its side, its shredded fibres curling up on the downwind face and tumbling back under itself, dark, chaotic and lumpy, visibly rotating end over end along its length. A chain of four pale translucent bell-shaped gasbag creatures with woven gondolas on rigging lines holds level and steady in the clear air between the two, high above the churning roll and just below the almond clouds, well clear of the turbulence.
scene: Side-on cutaway of the air downwind of a dark ridge whose crest enters at the left edge of the frame and drops away to the right. Below the churning roll, dim broken ground. Clear air separates the serene upper region from the violent lower one.
camera: Level side-on view from downwind, wide enough to stack the serene almond clouds, the caravan, and the churning roll vertically in one frame.
light: Cold sunlight from the left rim-lighting the almond clouds' upper edges in pale mist; the churning roll left dark, muddy-shadowed and unlit so it reads as menace; ground in deep indigo shadow.
palette: Pale cool mist on the serene almonds above; deep indigo and dirty teal-grey on the churning roll below; near-black ridge and ground; one restrained cyan accent on the caravan.
style: Painterly naturalist cutaway plate; the calm above and the violence below rendered with obviously different brush energy — smooth glassy strokes above, torn broken strokes below.
detail_level: Crisp laminar edges on the almond clouds; heavy broken shredded texture on the roll; the caravan clear but small; ridge and ground kept dark and simple.
composition: Clear vertical division: serene almonds across the upper third, caravan holding in the clear middle band, churning roll across the lower third directly beneath the almonds. Keep the clear middle band and the plain sky at the RIGHT of the frame dark, empty and low-detail so overlaid callouts naming the calm layer and the turbulent layer read cleanly.
consistency_notes: The aerostats are living creatures: soft translucent bells, trailing tentacles, woven gondolas on rigging lines — no rigid hulls, no propellers, no engines. The caravan is calm, level and intact, holding well clear — it is not being damaged or thrown about. The contrast between the smooth almonds above and the torn churning roll below must be unmistakable. Cool Pandora palette, sparse cyan bioluminescence.
